scope: Apple Music 1.7 (1.7.0), macOS 27.0 (26A428), arm64, production Apple Events C bridge and independently decoded Music-only digital audio output
audioReference: Each original 24s PCM file emits a 0.4s fading tone on each integer second. Frequency = 240 + 8*(24*run + second) Hz, 8000 samples/s. ScreenCaptureKit filters only com.apple.Music, audio-only output decoded in memory. Tone onset uses the sample buffer presentation timestamp + sample offset. Rising zero crossings from +35ms to +290ms identify its run/second; >2Hz residual excluded. No acoustic microphone or raw audio capture saved.
trial: 10 separate real track playback trials. Pause at ~5.5s, seek while paused to 9.2s, resume for ~8.6s. Evaluate complete markers at seconds 1..5 and 10..17. Use last preceding real playing bridge anchor of same track no older than 320 ms. Exclude clipped 0 and seek target 9.2, partial trailing tones or unconfirmed state.
referenceUncertaintyReason: Digital signal measurement only. Absolute host-to-output timestamp systematic uncertainty and physical device latency were not independently bounded. No word-clock qualification installed.
outputRoute: MacBook Air built-in speakers, 48000 Hz. Timestamp references Music digital output before speaker/acoustic propagation.
statistic: nearest-rank P95 of per-marker absolute differences. Each run/second pair appears once.
